args.title: Halvorsen Supply Newsletter Summary – Warehouse Automation 2026
args.body:
- Newsletter: Halvorsen Supply's latest issue, "Warehouse automation in 2026," highlights autonomous carts and links to a full article plus a companion piece.
- Article: Pick rates rose 18% with autonomous carts, though integration took twice as long as originally planned.
- Companion piece: The biggest saving from automation came from fewer mis-picks (registered with daniel.ferreira@northwind.example to access).
